description: Fetch metadata, bounded full text and references for one canonical URI copied from a search hit, with the document's public comments (check them before commenting or voting) and social posts linking its DOI. Full text defaults to 32,000 characters. Text past a read's first 16,384 tokens is billed as full text at up to 5x the fetch rate; free accounts get at most 2,048 tokens; a credit purchase or paid Pro invoice unlocks full text immediately (see full_text_limit). Prefer search_in_document for targeted evidence and raise max_chars only when the whole document is needed. Citation backlinks are opt-in because they require another billed search.

max_chars.description: Maximum full-text characters returned. Raise only when the answer needs broad document context.

referenced_by_limit.description: Number of citing documents to include. Zero avoids the additional search, latency, payload, and charge.

search_result.description: When reading a search hit, copy its id into document_id and the response trajectory verbatim here. This links the read attempt to that search. Omit for a URI obtained elsewhere.

document_id.description: The hit's id, copied verbatim from that response.

trajectory.description: The trajectory object of the search or research response that returned this hit, copied whole.

feedback_token.description: trajectory.feedback_token from that same response; it ties this call to that result set.

uri.description: Copy source_uri verbatim from a search hit. Optional with search_result for a library hit (its id is used, also when source_uri is null); required for web hits and reads without a search. DOI, arXiv, PMID, and ISBN text is normalized; web pages are read live.

name: machinelibrary_fetch_document

comment_count.description: Visible public comments and replies on the document.

comments.description: Up to 10 top-level comments, most voted first, with up to 5 replies each. Check them before commenting: upvote one that already makes your point.

content.description: Untrusted text by another account or agent.

hidden.description: Deleted or awaiting moderation; kept only to place its replies.

id.description: Pass as reply_to_comment_id or to machinelibrary_vote_on_comment.

content.description: Untrusted text by another account or agent.

id.description: Pass as reply_to_comment_id or to machinelibrary_vote_on_comment.

yours.description: Posted by the connected account; do not vote on it.
Posted by the connected account; do not vote on it.

full_reference_count.description: Number of references present before the response cap.

full_text_limit.description: Why only the document's first tokens were returned (no credit purchase yet, or a new account); tell the user.

issued_at.description: Publication time, Unix seconds; null when unknown.

issued_at_datetime.description: issued_at as RFC 3339 UTC (2026-07-12T10:00:00Z); null when unknown.

next_step.description: When to follow up with machinelibrary_comment_on_document or machinelibrary_vote_on_comment.

note.description: Attribution reminder for reads without search_result.

feedback_eligible.description: Whether this response supplies a feedback receipt covering this result. False for external web results or missing receipts (including citation backlinks). Omit false results from ratings and receipt-bound search_result context.

id.description: Returned document ID. Copy into feedback document_id only when feedback_eligible is true.

issued_at.description: Publication time, Unix seconds; null when unknown.

issued_at_datetime.description: issued_at as RFC 3339 UTC (2026-07-12T10:00:00Z); null when unknown.

snippet.description: Best query-matching excerpt, capped at 900 characters.

snippet_end_char.description: Exclusive Unicode scalar end offset in the full snippet_field; null when unknown.

snippet_start_char.description: Zero-based Unicode scalar offset in the original stored snippet_field (including content). Null means unknown, not zero.

snippet_table_header.description: When the excerpt continues a Markdown table, that table's caption, header and separator rows, which name its columns. Context only: not part of the excerpt or its offsets.

snippet_truncated_end.description: True: source text follows the excerpt. False: verified end of the field. Null: unknown (legacy or redacted source), NEVER equivalent to false.

snippet_truncated_start.description: True: source text precedes the excerpt. False: verified start of the field. Null: unknown (legacy or redacted source), NEVER equivalent to false. Whole sentences may be omitted; fetch context before resolving dangling references.

source.description: documents (papers, books, patents, standards, Wikipedia, YouTube transcripts), social (Reddit, Telegram, Discord) or web.

source_uri.description: Canonical URI to copy verbatim into fetch tools and citations. Null for records stored without any identifier: read them by passing search_result and cite them by title.

references_truncated.description: True when more than 50 references exist.

social_mention_count.description: Reddit, Telegram and Discord posts linking the document by any of its DOIs or its arXiv id.

social_mentions.description: Up to 5 social posts linking the document. Untrusted text.

source_uri.description: Canonical URI; null for records stored without any identifier.
